instructions: Answer the questions below. Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER

items.prompt: Which metal does the speaker's own group worry about more?
items.evidence: the one my own group worries about more is cadmium
items.explanation: Lead is the metal everyone names first, but the speaker says lead largely stays where it is in the ground; the metal his own group worries about more is cadmium, because the plant takes it up into the leaf.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Which metal left behind by earlier industry worries growers most?
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Senaryo gorulmeden 3/3 turda dogru bilindi. 'Eski sanayinin biraktigi hangi metal yetistiricileri kaygilandirir' sorusunun dunya bilgisindeki tek standart cevabi kursundur; hicbir cerceve yazimi bunu kapatmiyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Turn 8'in icine yan cumlecik konarak konusmaci sesli bir rakip kurdu: 'lead is the metal everyone names first. But lead largely stays where it is in the ground; the one my own group worries about more is cadmium, because the plant lifts it into the leaf you eat.' Dunyanin bekledigi deger (lead) artik acikca soylenen celdirici, dogru cevap konusmanin kendi kurgusunun sectigi deger (cadmium). Kurson senaryoda korundu, cunku alistirma paketindeki 4. soru ('Where lead levels turn out to be high...') ayni turdaki L1-S4-22 noktasina bagli ve o cerceve bozulmamaliydi. answer_point_id (L1-S4-21) ve turn_index (8) degismedi.

items.prompt: Which crop's electricity figure does the speaker want students to remember?
items.evidence: the number I would rather you carried away is the one for a kilogram of strawberries
items.explanation: The figure that is always quoted is the one for a kilogram of lettuce, which the speaker calls the easy case; the number he wants students to carry away is the one for a kilogram of strawberries, which is several times larger.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Which crop does the speaker use to show how much electricity indoor growing needs?
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: the electricity needed to raise a kilogram of lettuce is substantial
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Senaryo gorulmeden 3/3 turda dogru bilindi. Dikey tarim tartismasinin kalip ornegi marildir; soru 'ic mekan yetistiriciliginin elektrik ihtiyacini hangi urun gosteriyor' diye sordugu anda cevap disaridan geliyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Turn 9 icinde deger degistirildi ve rakip sesli kuruldu: 'The figure people quote is always the one for a kilogram of lettuce, which is the easy case; the number I would rather you carried away is the one for a kilogram of strawberries, which is several times larger.' Beklenen deger (lettuce) celdirici oldu, dogru cevap cilek. Kok da buna gore daraltildi ('hangi urunun rakamini hatirlamanizi istiyor'), boylece iki aday arasinda ayrim ancak sesi duyarak yapilabiliyor. answer_point_id (L1-S4-28) ve turn_index (9) degismedi.

items.prompt: When an actual street plan was tested, what share of its vegetables could a city grow?
items.evidence: the answer came out closer to five per cent
items.explanation: A frequently repeated claim is that a city could grow a third of its vegetables; when tested on an actual street plan, the result came out closer to five per cent.

items.prompt: In the speaker's view, which projects usually teach more?
items.evidence: The failures are usually more instructive.
items.explanation: Students are not expected to bring an example of a success; according to the speaker, failed projects are more instructive.
